name: Penrose
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Domain, Substance and Style programs to optimised SVG diagrams of sets, geometry and concepts
summary: Penrose compiles a Domain, Substance and Style trio and solves the layout by optimisation, returning SVG whose labels are MathJax paths. One Style file restyles many diagrams, and a fixed variation string reproduces a layout. Its strength is mathematical and conceptual explainer stills; it makes stills, not motion.
use_when: Mathematical or conceptual diagrams (sets, geometry, vectors) from notation, not drawn by hand
One Style restyling many diagrams, where the layout should be solved, not placed
A reproducible layout pinned by a variation string, over d2 or graphviz which lay out graphs and flows
avoid_when: Architecture or flow graphs: d2, graphviz or mermaid-cli
Animated layouts: untested, treat it as a stills tool
notes: 2026-11-27: lead named a global @penrose/roger install and a native-cli route; the fixture used @penrose/core in Node with jsdom instead, which needs no global or native install. roger 3.3.1 pulls native canvas.

assessment.rationale: npm @penrose/core 3.3.1 (latest) MIT, published 2026-08-30; repository pushed 2026-11-06. Solves layout of mathematical diagrams that d2, graphviz and mermaid-cli do not target; fixed variation gives repeatable output on this machine.

evidence.result: Three-set trio compiled twice in separate Node 22.19.0 processes with a fixed variation: identical SHA-256 bd6fc945…91c5, 3892 bytes, 3 circles, 0 text; a second variation differed and kept the constraints; resvg 800x600 PNG inspected.
evidence.scope: One Venn-style trio, @penrose/core 3.3.1 with jsdom 22.1.0, Equation labels, macOS arm64, one machine; not other Style features, Text shapes, roger, other platforms or motion.
